import parse
# Test various edge cases
tests = [
    '{foo',           # unclosed brace
    'foo}',           # lone closing brace
    '{{foo}',         # double opening brace
    '{foo}}',         # extra closing brace
    '{foo{bar}',      # nested opening brace
    '{foo}bar}',      # extra closing brace after valid field
]
for t in tests:
    try:
        p = parse.Parser(t)
        print(f'{t!r}: OK -> {p._expression}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{t!r}: ERROR -> {e}')
"
